80672.meaning1: having gone off; having gone away (from)
80672.commentary: (PYt) ukkamitvā'ti pakkamitvā. yo jaṅghamaggo otarati, so na vaṭṭatī'ti yojanā.

examples.text: tevijjāvivanan'ti pupphaphalehi aparibhogarukkhehi sañchannaṃ nirudakaṃ araññaṃ. yattha maggato ukkamitvā parivattitum'pi na sakkā honti, taṃ sandhāy'āha tevijjāvivanan'ti'pi vuccatī'ti.

80673.meaning1: relishing; enjoying the taste (of); taking pleasure (in); liking
80673.commentary: (MNt) nibbānaṃ assādento'ti paramaṃ sukhaṃ nissaraṇan'ti maññanāya assādento.

examples.text: yojanānayo pan'ettha sabbaṃ assādento sabbaṃ taṇhāmaññanāya maññati. mayā ete sattā nimmitā'ti-ādinā nayena attanā nimmitaṃ maññanto sabbaṃ mānamaññanāya maññati.

80674.meaning1: previously done action; previously performed kamma

examples.text: atha brahmā cintesi, samaṇo gotamo mayhaṃ āyuñ'ca nibbattaṭṭhānañ'ca pubbekatakammañ'ca jānāti, handa naṃ pubbe katakammaṃ pucchāmī'ti satthāraṃ attano pubbekatakammaṃ pucchi. satthā kathesi.

esa nayo nibbānato maññanāya'pi. tatra'pi hi nibbānato aññaṃ attānaṃ gahetvā idaṃ nibbānaṃ, ayaṃ attā, so kho pana me ayaṃ attā ito nibbānato añño'ti maññanto nibbānato maññati, ayam'assa diṭṭhimaññanā.
attā attaniyo me'ti, passato naṃ abuddhino, ādāse viya bondhissa, diṭṭhiyā hoti maññanā.
vipassanāmattavasen'evā'ti avadhāraṇena samathaṃ nivatteti. so hi tassā paṭiyogī, na sīl'ādi. matta-saddena ca visesanivatti-atthena savisesaṃ samādhiṃ nivatteti.

80680.commentary: (VINa) dve magge ādissā'ti'ādi yen'ākārena obhāsato saṅgh'ādiseso hoti, taṃ dassetuṃ vuttaṃ. tattha dve magge'ti vaccamaggañ'ca passāvamaggañ'ca.

ārammaṇaṃ pana heṭṭhā puggalānam'pi tadeva, imesam'pi tadevā'ti. tena vuttaṃ ārammaṇasabhāgena puggalaṃ sampiṇḍeti no puggalasabhāgenā'ti. yo'pi so'ti iminā pana sakalena vacanena idāni vattabbaṃ sekkhaṃ dassetī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: tena ca ārammaṇasabhāgena puggalaṃ sampiṇḍeti, no puggalasabhāgena, heṭṭhato hi puggalā diṭṭhivipannā, idha diṭṭhisampannā, na tesaṃ sabhāgatā atthi. ārammaṇaṃ pana heṭṭhā puggalānam'pi tadeva, imesam'pi tadevā'ti.

80691.commentary: (JAa) seyyo'va vaḷavā bhojjho'ti vaḷavā'ti sindhavakulesu ajāto khaluṅk'asso. bhojjho'ti bhoj'ājānīyasindhavo. iti etasmā vaḷavā sallehi viddho'pi bhojājānīyasindhavo'va seyyo varo uttamo.

examples.text: api passena semāno, sallebhi sallalīkato, seyyo'va vaḷavā bhojjo, yuñja maññ'eva sārathī'ti.

80692.commentary: (VVa) sabbakālikan'ti sabbakāle sukhaṃ sabba-utusappāyaṃ, sabbakāle pupphanakaṃ vā. (JAa) sabbakālikā'ti sabbakālaparibhogakkhamā niccapupphitā vā. (JAa) sabbakālikan'ti chasu'pi utūsu uppajjanaka-puppha-phala-sañchannaṃ. kaṇikāravan'ādīsu sabbakālikan'ti sabbakāle supupphitaphalitam'eva.

examples.text: tamhā vimānā oruyha, nimmitā ratanāmayā, ogāhasi sālavanaṃ, pupphitaṃ sabbakālikaṃ.
ayam'assa asokavanikā, supupphitā sabbakālikā rammā, yahim'anuvicari rājā, parikiṇṇo itth'āgārehi.
te ten'eva ca kāraṇena viññāṇaṭṭhiti-satt'āvāsa-vasena'pi na gahitā, sabbakālikā pana imā maññanā. tasmā tāsaṃ sadāvijjamānabhūmiṃ dassento suddh'āvāse atikkamitvā, ākās'ānañc'āyatanan'ti-ādim'āha.

80694.meaning1: (abhi) indeterminate as to wholesomeness or unwholesomeness; neither skilful nor unskilful; functional, resultant or materiality
80694.construction: na > a + vi > vy > by + ā + √kar + ta
80694.commentary: (ADha) na byākatā'ti abyākatā, kusal'ākusalabhāvena akathitā'ti attho. tesu pana anavajjasukhavipākalakkhaṇā kusalā, sāvajjadukkhavipākalakkhaṇā akusalā, avipākalakkhaṇā abyākatā.

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye kām'āvacarassa kusalassa kammassa katattā upacitattā vipākaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ uppannaṃ hoti upekkhāsahagataṃ rūp'ārammaṇaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti, vedanā hoti, saññā hoti, cetanā hoti, cittaṃ hoti, upekkhā hoti, cittass'ek'aggatā hoti, man'indriyaṃ hoti, upekkh'indriyaṃ hoti, jīvit'indriyaṃ hoti, ye vā pana tasmiṃ samaye aññe'pi atthi paṭiccasamuppannā arūpino dhammā, ime dhammā abyākatā.

80695.meaning1: who is far away from defilements

examples.text: arahan'ti ārakakileso, dūrakileso pahīnakileso'ti attho. vuttañ'c'etaṃ bhagavatā kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti?

80696.commentary: (ADha) yato tato vā niyyān'aṭṭhena upakārakāni kusal-ādi-bhedāni dvādasa magg'aṅgāni maggapaccayo.

examples.text: āmantā. hañci vīriyādhipati sahajātānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhipati, tañ'ca magg'aṅgaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe, adhipatipaccayena paccayo, maggapaccayena paccayo'ti.
yāni sam'odakaṃ ṭhitāni, tāni sve pupphanakāni. yāni udak'ānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, tāni tatiyadivase pupphanakāni.

imāni hi satte bhavesu saṃyojenti upanibandhanti, bhavaṃ vā bhavena saṃyojenti, tasmā bhavasaṃyojanānī'ti vuccanti. imāni bhavasaṃyojanāni arahato parikkhīṇāni pahīnāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni, tena vuccati parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano'ti.
